title: Microbot Medical Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Microbot Medical Inc. (ticker: MBOT) filed a Form 8-K on April 13, 2026, announcing the limited market release of its LIBERTY Endovascular Robotic System and the upcoming full U.S. market release at the Society of Interventional Radiology Annual Scientific Meeting (April 11-15, 2026). The company has expanded its commercial sales team from four to eight territories with a goal of twelve territories by year-end 2026.
key_points: Microbot Medical announced limited market release of LIBERTY Endovascular Robotic System on April 13, 2026
Full U.S. market release scheduled for SIR Annual Scientific Meeting in Toronto, ON, Canada (April 11-15, 2026)
LIBERTY has been adopted by multiple healthcare systems including Emory Healthcare and Tampa General Hospital

Commercial procedures completed include Prostate Artery Embolization (PAE), Uterine Fibroid Embolization (UFE), Genicular Artery Embolization (GAE), Y90 mapping, Y90 deliveries, and peripheral arterial interventions
Company expanded sales footprint from four to eight territories; goal of twelve territories by end of 2026
Company is traded on NASDAQ Capital Market under ticker MBOT
